summary: Independent review approves the amended frozen Unicode maintenance design against the newly reclassified native context, which exactly matches the supplied context. The specification now explicitly reconciles the four task-forbidden actions with existing conditional standing authorization; it does not create unconditional publication authority or alter Policy, repository permissions or quality thresholds. The observed freeze, same-route spec_changed escalation, evidence-backed resolution and native reclassification preserve earlier event and review records, retain REVIEW/V1 without downgrade and leave a fresh classification awaiting specification approval. The previous design review is retained as history and is not treated as approval of this new context. The technical design remains the smallest direct standard-library correction: UTF-8 text-stream readlines preserves valid Unicode separators within event strings, and ASCII escaping only facts output avoids the reproduced GBK emoji failure while preserving decoded values, event bytes, apply, preview and no-op behavior. Companion analysis changes remain a separate task-free commit. Existing parsing, replay, validation and I/O errors, private-field projection limits, source-byte preservation and historical failures remain acceptance requirements. Implementation review, full native quality verification, Gate, remote required CI and merge-commit publication require separate evidence; real scoring, automatic-review arrangement, host connections and observation start remain paused. No open design findings remain.
